theme_and_archetype.description: A precise, highly functional, and information-dense UI. Moving away from standard VS Code colors toward a cleaner, refined 'Tactical Minimalism' with strong data-visualization emphasis. Dark Sky inspired data bars.

typography.description: Outfit provides clean, geometric legibility for UI labels and headings. IBM Plex Mono is strictly for all numbers, temperatures, metrics, and timestamps to ensure tabular alignment and a technical feel.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Cardless, full-width sections on mobile separated by 1px borders (`border-b border-subtle`). On larger screens, use a tight 3-column bento grid (`gap-4`).

component_patterns.list_items: Flex row, vertically centered, `border-b border-[#262626] last:border-0`, `py-3`.
component_patterns.severity_chips: Font size `text-xs`, uppercase, `px-2 py-1`, solid background with 10% opacity of the severity color, and 1px border of the exact severity color. Text color matches severity color.
component_patterns.magnitude_badges: Circle or rounded-square, `w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-sm font-bold`. Background is the magnitude tier color, text is deep contrast (e.g., `#121212` for lighter tiers, `#FFFFFF` for M7+).
component_patterns.tab_bar: Fixed bottom, `h-16`, `bg-[#121212]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#262626]`. Flex evenly distributed. Active state uses `#3B82F6` icon/text, inactive uses `#A3A3A3`.
component_patterns.sheet_modal: Slide up from bottom, `bg-[#1E1E1E]`, top corners rounded `rounded-t-xl`, drag handle pill at the top.
component_patterns.map_picker: Full-bleed container. Use dark-styled map tiles. Central target reticle.
component_patterns.weather_timeline: Horizontal scroll `overflow-x-auto snap-x flex-row gap-4 py-4`. Custom scrollbar hidden. Use stylized vertical bars for precipitation probability.
component_patterns.guest_banner: Sticky at top under header. `bg-[#7F1D1D] text-[#FECACA] text-xs py-1 px-4 text-center`. Non-blocking.

animation_micro_interactions.click: Scale down `active:scale-95` on buttons and list items.
animation_micro_interactions.pull_to_refresh: Standard mobile pull down. Use a spinning lucide-react 'RefreshCw' icon that fades in opacity based on pull distance.
animation_micro_interactions.transitions: Page transitions use subtle crossfade. Avoid heavy sliding.

iconography: lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a delicate, precise technical look.

testing_attributes.instruction: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this design using standard Tailwind CSS classes. Strictly avoid custom CSS where Tailwind suffices. Ensure 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Mono' fonts are properly imported (e.g., via Google Fonts) and applied via Tailwind config. Implement the bottom tab navigation to persist across main views. Apply the dark theme globally by default. DO NOT USE ANY placeholder images, use the provided unsplash urls. Include data-testid attributes on every interactive element.
